trends.name: Iran Conflict Escalating Energy Crisis
trends.summary: Israel-US attacks on Iranian energy infrastructure are spiking oil prices toward $120/barrel and threatening helium supplies critical for semiconductors and medical devices. Diesel prices hit record surge rates (+$1.44/gal in 4 weeks), and prediction markets now price gasoline near $4.30/gal. The Pentagon is requesting $200 billion for potential Iranian war escalation, signaling this conflict will persist and continue pressuring energy markets.

trends.name: Tesla FSD Safety Probe & Regulatory Risk
trends.summary: NHTSA opened formal engineering analysis on 3.2M Tesla vehicles with Full Self-Driving over degradation detection system failures. This intensifies regulatory scrutiny of autonomous driving claims and poses material risk to Tesla's valuation if FSD rollout faces restrictions or mandatory recalls.

trends.name: Micron AI Demand Constraint Despite Earnings
trends.summary: Micron posted blowout earnings but stock fell 3% because CEO stated the company can supply only a fraction of key customer (AI chipmaker) needs, revealing severe capacity constraints. This signals semiconductor supply-demand imbalance will persist and limit growth for memory/logic suppliers despite strong demand.

trends.name: Fed Not Cutting Rates, Inflation Shock Unresolved
trends.summary: Fed is holding rates steady with no cuts in sight, differing sharply from 2020 crisis response. Current inflation shock is not being accommodated, and ECB warns outlook is 'significantly more uncertain.' This suggests rate environment will remain restrictive, pressuring valuations and growth stocks.

trends.name: US Diesel/Fuel Crisis & Transport Costs Spiking
trends.summary: Diesel prices surging at record speed (largest 4-week increase ever at +$1.44/gal) driven by Iran conflict and refinery constraints. Market betting gas near $4.30/gal this month. Maersk implementing emergency fuel surcharges for Nordic shipments, indicating logistics/transport cost inflation will cascade through supply chains.

trends.name: Eurozone Construction Contraction & Recession Signals
trends.summary: Eurozone construction output fell -0.1% M/M and -1.9% Y/Y, signaling economic weakness. Combined with ECB's warning of 'significantly more uncertain' outlook and housing weakness signals (US home sales at 2022 lows), recession risk is escalating in developed markets.

trends.name: Crypto Regulation & Donation Crackdowns
trends.summary: UK lawmakers seeking moratorium on crypto donations to political parties while Crypto.com cuts 12% workforce citing AI. Regulatory pressures on digital assets are intensifying globally, creating headwinds for crypto-exposed companies and investors.

trends.name: EV/Battery Makers Pivot to Energy Storage
trends.summary: EV battery manufacturers (including Ford suppliers) are shifting focus toward energy storage for data centers and utilities as AI infrastructure demand explodes. This pivot reflects structural shift in battery demand from automotive to AI/data center segments.

trends.name: Institutional Gold Selling, Retail Buying Divergence
trends.summary: Retail investors bought +$70 billion in gold ETFs since Q2 2025 (tripled in 6 months) while institutions sold -$1 billion. China continues 16-month gold buying streak (50 tonnes acquired). This divergence suggests retail hedging against inflation/geopolitical risk while institutions rebalance away.

trends.name: Software Stock Repricing & AI Doomsday Concern
trends.summary: Smart money fled software stocks following viral AI doomsday report, rotating capital elsewhere. This reflects growing skepticism on AI monetization and concerns about technology disruption outpacing valuation assumptions in software sector.

trends.name: Trump Admin Defense Spending & Iran War Contingency
trends.summary: Pentagon requesting $200 billion for potential Iran war; Trump wants no more strikes on Iranian energy but conflict escalates. Defense sector and geopolitical hedges (energy, gold) should outperform in this scenario.

trends.name: Rivian-Uber Robotaxi Partnership & EV Momentum
trends.summary: Uber investing up to $1.25B in Rivian to launch 50,000 robotaxis, signaling renewed momentum in autonomous vehicle and EV infrastructure plays. This validates long-term mobility/transportation transformation narrative despite near-term EV market challenges.
